data.narrative:
Singularity is a Series A-stage defense and security company seeking valuation guidance against a peer universe of 10 private and 2 public comparables, including Stark Defence, Castelion, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing. The company has raised $82M to date and carries a post-money valuation of $400M from its most recent round.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $400M last post-money valuation and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical for Series A advancement, yields $800M. Peer-median analysis across three same-sector, same-stage comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B), Castelion ($1.0B), and NODA AI ($125M)—produces a median of $1.0B, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects material heterogeneity within the frontier defense-tech cohort.

These methods triangulate to a valuation range of $680M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $900M. The current $400M valuation sits materially below this implied range, suggesting undervaluation if peer comparability and stage-progression assumptions hold. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the three-company peer median given the 32x spread between floor and ceiling valuations, as well as the applicability of standard 2.0x stage-step multiples in a sector characterized by outsized outlier outcomes. Revenue scale, customer concentration, and technology differentiation remain material value drivers not captured in this framework.
